In this cut the outfit itself shows that game character: its recognisable colours, shapes and parts. She is a woman wearing that character's cosplay — she is not that character. Everything else follows SCENE (chosen).

FRAME: a vertical 2:3 (1024×1536) image. Compose the image for this frame; COMPOSITION in SCENE sets how much of her shows.

SCREENS: any monitor, cabinet, handheld, box or poster shows only abstract colored light, simple shapes or blank art — no recognisable game, character, logo, title or interface, no readable text.

SCENE (chosen):

overall_intensity: strong — maximal styling presence within the scene; retain chosen exposure and anatomy
skin_exposure: bold — more scene-appropriate shoulder, back, midriff or leg exposure; cover chest and pelvis
action_level: balanced — a readable moment of gentle movement, not a ratio of multiple images
separates_preference: balanced — choose either a one-piece outfit or separates to suit the scene

WARDROBE: change her clothes completely into the cosplay SCENE describes. From the attached image take only her face and hair — not its armor, garment, jewelry, hair ornaments or background. ANGLE: the attached image fixes who she is, not how she is posed or shot. ONE FIGURE ONLY. No second character, no creature beside her, no text, no lettering, no logo, no watermark, no speech bubble, no frame border.
